en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the man prepares his shroud, so he would be Recompensed every time he looks towards it’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
if a person keeps his shroud ready, for each time he looks on it he is entitled to one reward.”
